guide.what: Implied volatility of the S&P 500 (the market's 30-day fear gauge).
read: High and rising volatility comes with scarce liquidity and falling markets; low and stable volatility with abundant liquidity.
Read it next to the real rate: low real rates have gone with a low VIX.
watch: Spikes are fast and mean-reverting; what matters for a 20-60 day book is whether volatility is trending up.
